scenario: LCCO.8.4 — an `error:` body sees the matched CallError bound as `error`, so `{error.code}` and `{error.message}` in its log message resolve and the program compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.scoped_continuation`'s `acont_error` arm, which binds `error` as a `CallError` for the clause's actions. Twin of LCCO.8.4_err_is_not_bound.
rules_ds:
service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        error:
            log info "call failed: {error.code} {error.message}"
